original:
Repeat the above procedure until we first get $a\leq s$ .
We then have $a\in\{s-2,s-1,s\}$ , so that the final distribution $(a,b,c)$ is one of

 $(s,s-3,s),\hskip 20.00003pt(s-1,s-1,s-1),\hskip 20.00003pt(s-2,s+1,s-2).$
